description: Original generated botanical flower heads and butterflies; alpha-preserving sprite atlas. No external artwork copied.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production sprite atlas for a sophisticated immersive interactive night garden installation. Create an exquisite botanical specimen sheet, exactly 3 columns by 2 rows of SIX separate isolated subjects on a truly TRANSPARENT background. Wide landscape canvas, ratio 3:2, each subject centered in its own equal square cell with generous transparent padding (at least 12% per cell), no overlapping subjects or cell edges. No grid lines, labels, text, border, cast shadows, floor or scenery.
Top row: three flower HEADS ONLY, facing viewer, no stems, no leaves: left an intricate blush-pink dahlia with many concentric curved petals, middle a pale lavender-blue cosmos/anemone with softly curled veined petals and dark indigo/gold detailed stamen center, right a warm ivory/peach chrysanthemum with many delicate long narrow petals and luminous gold heart. Each flower fills about 70% of cell width, round radial silhouette, off-axis organic delicacy. Bloom style: museum-quality botanical realism meets luminous digital fine art, translucent silk petal surfaces, exquisite fine veins, volumetric light and soft luminous edges. Rich shading and material depth, not flat illustration.
Bottom row: THREE butterflies seen directly from ABOVE with BOTH WINGS fully spread symmetrically, body exactly vertical at horizontal center of each cell, head up. Left iridescent blue Morpho butterfly with dark ink scalloped wing edges, subtle cyan spots and fine wing veins. Middle dusky rose and lavender swallowtail with cream spots, layered wing patterns and two elegant small tail tips. Right amber/coral butterfly with fine dark vein network and ivory dots on wing margins. Anatomically convincing TWO pairs of wings each, fine antennae and slim bodies, no cartoon faces. Butterfly wings fill about 75% of each cell width and no subject crosses its cell. Restrained bioluminescent edge highlights that read beautifully against midnight plum. The six subjects should be visually rich, exceptionally detailed, elegant and credible, never cartoon clip art. Alpha must be transparent, do not draw a checkerboard.
